02-welcome-pack.verdict: The e4 centred card is a real step toward the guide, but it still has an explaining paragraph, rarity-coloured names, a heavy 'Take the pack' button and a bare close button with no X; the e1 full-screen slab is the exact pattern the guide deletes.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The hub floor is a readable playground but not a polished AAA screen: station labels are oversized and equal-weight, there is no clear primary action, and the corner text, test-build joke caption and cramped footer ignore the style guide.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: the card now fills the screen with an x in the corner, but the earlier advice was mostly not followed: the stash is still a dense console with a wall of small mono text, two help lines, a lime freebie bar and a toast, and no single thing the eye lands on first.
findings: P0 card header (pillagers / the undercroft subtitle, credits row, backdrop title): delete 'pillagers' and the subtitle. set 'stash' at 32px f-cond 700 tx-1, 24px from the left edge. show credits as one 56px f-cond 800 hero or a single 20px stat, and drop xp and bag to a 16px tx-2 line. raise the scrim to .80 so the backdrop title is hidden.

P0 bottom half: key legend, 'hover an item and press j' line, freebie bar, toast: delete the j hint and the first-raid sentence. shorten the freebie to 'issued gear: pistol, 2 bandages, frag, plate'. keep the legend as one 14px footer line. move the toast to top-centre and dismiss it after 3s. remove the empty row at y≈870.

P0 lime accents: first-raid banner, freebie bar, gun key digits, stash tab, loadout title: make 'take the freebie kit' a filled --acc button, 56px high, --acc-ink text, 20px f-cond 700, right aligned. remove the banner border and the olive bar fill (use --ui-panel). set the gun key digits and labels to tx-1.

P1 right column: backpack, tactical belt, gun keys, item wheel: show the backpack as two full rows with no clip. use one 56px cell on an 8px gap for belt, gun keys and wheel. delete the 'guns' caption. move gun keys and wheel to a tab, or a 2-column block aligned to the 24px padding. align reset to the right edge at 16px.
P1 type throughout: use f-cond 600 at 16px minimum with +.04em tracking, section headers 20px f-cond 700 tx-1. keep f-mono only for table numbers. fix the tab row height to 56px.

05-sector-page.verdict: removing the cash stepper left a half-empty row and an orphaned grey item, and the panel's old problems (a dense stat sentence over a big patch of empty black space) are still untouched.
findings: P1 pack grid, second row (bandage / burst carbine (field) / compact smg (field) / no data core): stretch the 4 remaining cells to the same total width as row 1 (4 equal cells minus 3x 24px gaps) so both rows terminate at the same x, or add a filler stat cell to row 2.

P1 pack grid, "no data core" cell: either give it the same disabled -/0/0/+/max shape as the other cells so the grid stays uniform, or pull it out of the item grid into a one-line "locked: data core" footnote under the grid.

P2 "cold storage / ascending here" info panel: split the stats into 3-4 short label/value chips at fs-label (16px) with the numbers bumped to fs-body (20px) for hierarchy, per the style guide's stat-chip intent, and either shrink the panel or use the freed space for a zone list.
P2 tooltip "the welcome pack is in your stash." top center: anchor it with a pointer to the stash/pack control it refers to, or convert it to a dismissible banner row inside the card body.
P2 pack row, "pack all" / "clear" buttons: right-align pack all/clear in their own small group with extra gap (sp-3, 24px) separating them from the item cells, or box them in a thin divider.

06-terms.verdict: the terms window sits in the right 90% card with an x, but the content is a small, gray, low-contrast column floating in a huge empty card with no focus state, no primary action and a misaligned footer.
findings: P0 whole card / content block: top-align a 56px header row (title left at 32px, x at right) and widen the list to the card's inner width, or scale rows to 80px high with 20px names. Fill the card instead of centring a 520px stack.

P0 row text and sign buttons: names 20px tx-1 f-cond 600; descriptions 16px tx-2; bonus as 24px lime (--acc) f-cond 700 right-aligned; sign buttons 96x44 with a 2px lime border on the focused row and a raised fill (--ui-raised) on that row. Show a visible focus state on the first row by default.

P1 footer: 'nothing signed...' line, divider and 'sign nothing' button: align the divider, status and button to the list edges (x=431 to 1489). Put 'sign nothing' bottom-right in a 72px footer row, 24px from the list. Make the status line 16px tx-2 and put the one bright element on the main action.
P1 intro paragraph: cut to one short line (e.g. 'sign for worse conditions, earn more if you extract') at 16px with a measure under 70 characters, or delete it.
P1 title 'the terms': set the title to 32px f-cond 700 tx-1, left-aligned in a 56px header row with the x at the same baseline; drop the underline or make it a 36px x 2px lime tab.

07-party-coop.verdict: the f2 card now reads as a proper 90% window with an x, but the content is a small, dense text block floating in an empty slab, with weak buttons, no focus state and a toast overlapping the card edge.
findings: P0 top-left of the f1 shot (0,0 to 686x278): remove the orphan panel, or confirm it is the career hud. render the party card at 90% width and height (about 1728x972, centred) in every state, as f2 does.

P1 whole card content (title, copy, buttons): align the title to the left at the 32px title size in a 56px header row with the x on the same baseline. put the body in a column about 720px wide on the left and a raised detail pane on the right, or centre the block vertically with 48px padding.

P1 intro paragraph, trading paragraph, join hint: cut to one line of 16px at most, for example 'up to 4 pillagers, one raid'. move the trading how-to to a tooltip or the tutorial. never go below 16px for anything read.

P1 host a party / join a party buttons: make host a party the primary button with an --acc fill and --acc-ink text, 48px tall, 20px type. make join a ghost button. line up the left edges at x=431. put the code input and join on one row, with a lime focus ring on the focused control.

P1 invite code input (564,596 to 1489,655): make it a 48px high field, about 480px wide, with the placeholder 'invite code' centred vertically at 20px. put join a party directly to its right with an 8px gap.

08-shop.verdict: the tiles now have icons and the layout is tidier, but most of the earlier advice was not followed: the grid is still a third full with a dead lower half, the flavour pill still sits on the panel edge, and the header still has the currency clutter and a crowded close button.
findings: P0 grid panel, x 119-1307, y 190-1002: use a 6-column grid of tiles that stretch to the panel width (about 190px square, 8px gutters). add small section labels (medical, ammo, gear) at 16px tx-2 to fill the space. or end the panel at the last row.

P0 flavour pill 'everything here works. cannot say the same for you.', x 767-1153, y 975-1012: delete it. add the 72px footer row (y 952-1024) with a ghost 'back' button (B glyph) on the left and the 14px key legend on the right.
P1 header right, x 1414-1807, y 67-115: keep one block: '900' at 20px tx-1 and 'credits' at 16px tx-2. move xp, stash and bag to the footer legend. leave 24px between the block and the 48x48 x.
P1 title, x 119-335, y 82-110: title it 'shop' at 32px f-cond 700. let the tabs carry craft and hire.
P1 tabs, x 119-290, y 145-180: set tabs at 20px f-cond 600 with 24px side padding and 48px height. a 3px lime underline, one divider only, and the strip on the title row or directly under it.

09-craft.verdict: The craft grid is clean and readable, but the screen is a top-heavy template with a dead lower half, a cream detail card that clashes with the dark UI, and a header that collides and shows redundant currency.

10-hire.verdict: A tidy but generic grid, undermined by a loud red glitch banner that outranks everything, a washed-out cream detail panel with a disabled-looking Hire button, and duplicated currency and price data.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: A tidy but generic dark modal with no focal point: the title, two competing boxes and a pile of explanatory text all sit at similar weight, and the buttons look disabled and have no visible pad focus.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: it has the right card-and-x structure and a clear lime focus row, but the list is a flat wall of identical rows, the text is tiny and low-contrast for a couch, and the unused detail pane, clipped last row and overlapping toast make it feel unfinished.
findings: P1 contract list rows (left pane): drop the repeated 'standard' tag (show a tag only for hard or elite), set the row name to 20px tx-1 and the pays line to 16px tx-2 (min 4.5:1). Right-align the $ reward at 20px in a fixed column. Raise row height to 72px with 16px padding.
P1 selected row fill: use --ui-raised #1e2225 for the fill, a 4px solid --acc left bar, and tx-1 text. Optionally a 1px --acc-at-40% outline.

P1 bottom of list and toast ('the welcome pack is in your stash.'): fit the list to the card with 24px bottom padding and a fade or scroll indicator on the cut row. Move the toast to 24px above the card edge, outside the border, or inside the safe area, and shorten it or remove it.

P1 detail pane (right): stretch the pane to the full list height, pin the action button to the bottom at 56px tall, and make the progress bar 8px with an --acc fill. Enlarge the reward icon to 56px with a 16px count. State the disabled state in tx-2 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P2 header stats (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): use one pattern for all three: a 20px tx-1 number plus a 16px tx-2 label, 32px gaps. Split stash and bag into two items. Use '$' consistently for money ('$600', not '600 c' and not 'credits' next to '$').

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: the mainframe racks tab still has the old layout of one narrow column of grey buttons with explaining paragraphs, a huge empty right half, and a dev-joke sentence about claude that must go.
findings: P0 import a friend paragraph, bottom of column: delete it. Leave at most a 16px tx-2 label of 5 words or fewer ('import a run report') and move the detail to a tooltip.

P0 whole racks tab layout: two columns with a 24px gap, both starting at the 118px margin. Left panel: rack grid and the three actions. Right --ui-raised detail pane: costs as a table with held/needed per material.

P0 description paragraphs under build a rack, fold, slot a data core: delete the sentences. Show costs as 16px chips ('scrap 0/12', 'wire 0/9', 'cell 0/6', 'board 0/6'), red where short. Move the data-core detail to a tooltip.

P1 build a rack / fold / slot a data core buttons: make 'build a rack' the one --acc fill with --acc-ink 20px text. Disabled buttons get tx-2 text at 4.5:1 or better and a --ui-line-hi border. Make 'import a friend' secondary. Add a 2px lime focus bar on the focused row.

P1 '0 of 10 racks' count and rack slots, top of column: set a 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 '0 / 10' as the hero. Make the slots 40x16 --ui-panel fills with --ui-line-hi borders, lime when filled. Drop the teal. Leave 24px below the tab rule.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: a full-size card that is mostly empty, with a small off-centre content block, a title that is too small and doesn't align with the content below it, and two identical lime buttons competing for attention, so it reads as a template rather than a bar menu.
findings: P1 whole card composition: Anchor a 56px header row at the top of the card with the title at left, 32px f-cond 700, 24px padding. Make the list fill the card width, with 72px rows and 16px gaps. Or move the content block up so it starts about 120px below the header.

P1 title 'the last pour' (y≈390): Left-align the title to x=431 and set it at 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Remove the short underline, or make it a 2px, 36px-wide accent tab. Add 24px between the title and the body copy.

P1 ingest buttons x2 and the $300/$520 prices: Make the prices tx-1 at 20px. Make the idle buttons outline-only (1px line-hi, tx-1). Fill the focused row's button with lime. Add a --ui-raised row fill and a 3px lime left bar on the focused row.

P1 descriptions and 'things are about to get real.': Delete 'things are about to get real.' and 'you hold $900' since the header already shows the balance. Keep one short effect line per row at 16px in tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Cut the long blotter sentence to about 6 words.

P2 top-right currency strip: Show '$900' with a 16px label, and use one size and weight for every item. Put 24px between items and a 1px divider before the stash/bag group. Show stash and bag as 'stash $3,750' and 'bag 0' at 16px, in tx-2 on --ui-panel.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: A competent dark-panel template with a clear two-column layout, but the grid is a wall of near-identical tiles, the operator preview is dwarfed, and the header, footer and list clip or crowd, so it reads as a debug inventory and not a Fortnite-grade fashion screen.

18-settings-hub.verdict: the left category nav and list-plus-controls layout fix the biggest structural problem from last time, but the settings card is still off-center with dead space, the audio rows bleed into the raid list, and the description block is still a paragraph of explaining text.
findings: P0 description block (x 417-1545, y 830-955): Cut the copy to one line of 16px tx-2, 90 characters at most (e.g. 'click any word to rewrite it. f2 toggles.'). Drop the repeated heading, or move the text into a 480px right-hand detail pane. Put 24px between the text and the footer rule.

P0 card composition (nav x 338, list right edge x 1582, header x 49, close x 1847): Use one content frame, x=49 to x=1871. Put the nav at x=49 (280px wide), the list from x=345 to x=1871, and run the description and footer rules across the same frame. Or add a 480px detail pane at the right to use the width.
P1 list rows (y 120-780): Show only the active tab's rows. Add a 16px lime-free section label if groups are needed. Snap the scroll to whole 56px rows and add a 24px bottom fade mask.

P1 value controls (x 1050-1337, rows 56px): Remove the border from the idle steppers. Right-align the stepper to the row padding (x≈1550) with a 240px value column. Use 24px chevrons in tx-2 on idle rows and in lime only on the focused row. Fill the focused row with --ui-raised.

P1 nav (x 338-602, y 118-570): Set the nav labels at 20px f-cond 600, with tx-1 on the active row and tx-2 on the others. Use 56px rows. Move 'send play data' into the footer as a ghost button, or into the accessibility tab.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The raid HUD is functional but cluttered: five or six competing text panels, a keybind cheat sheet that stays open, duplicated tooltips and tiny dense type leave no clear focal point and no consistent panel language.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The new version is lower case, the ammo panel has a real hierarchy and the career HUD is a tidy list, but the HUD is still a pile of unrelated boxes: the cheat sheet is still always on, the minimap and run info are bulky, the zone label is clipped behind the stats, and the type is tiny.
findings: P0 controls cheat sheet (bottom centre, x492-902, y697-867): Hide it by default and show a single 'f1 controls' chip (16px tx-2) for the first 30s only. If it stays, use 16px text, 24px padding, an --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, with keys in tx-1 and actions in tx-2. Remove the grip glyph.

P0 right column (x1582-1902, y18-695): Merge the four rows into one panel with 16px tx-2 labels and right-aligned 20px tx-1 numbers, 8px row gap, 24px inset. Move the zone label under the minimap or into the top-centre HUD. Shrink the minimap to about 240px, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, inset 48px from the screen edge.

P1 run info panel (x1583-1902, y533-695) and extraction chip (y702-725): Give all section heads the same 16px tx-2 style, with the title at tx-1 and 20px. Use a hanging indent for wrapped contract lines, or truncate them with an ellipsis. Dock the extract chip 8px under the panel, flush to the same left edge. Inset the whole column 48px from the right edge.

P1 ammo panel (x1578-1910, y893-1052) and status tag (x1720-1905, y803-832): Put the 'b backpack' hint at 16px tx-2 in the bottom row, with the item count and value as a single 16px tx-2 right-aligned line. Make the status tag a tx-1 text on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and no amber. Keep 8px clearance above the panel and 48px from the right and bottom edges.

P1 current pillagers list (top left, x10-390, y152-258): Show it on tab only, or at 40% opacity. Use an --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 24px padding and a 28px row pitch. Make the title tx-1 at 16px, and mark your own row with the accent. Inset it 48px from the edge.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: the camera change left this map overlay untouched, and the screen still reads as a crowded placeholder map with a toast bleeding outside the window.
findings: P0 bottom-left, 'codex entry · scav pistol · common' and 'contract item nearby' toast rows: clamp toast x-origin to card-left + 24px padding (style guide's panel padding), or move the toast to a layer that clips to the window card rect

P1 right edge cluster, 'strongbox'/'cache' icons (~1030-1060,353-470) next to 'extract b' and its own up-arrow extract icon (~1050,551): space icon anchors at least 48px apart (--sp-5) or move the strongbox box up/left so it has clear air from the extract-b cluster

P1 top strip, 'cache' box top-right corner (~1028,185-255): give the top-right cache box 16px internal padding between its two icons, and move 'foreman office · locked' label left by ~24px so it clears the box border
P1 whole map canvas: give locked/special rooms a distinct fill tint (e.g. --ui-raised for lootable rooms, a 1px --warn border on locked doors) so room type is visible without reading the label

P1 map pin icon set (cache dot-circle, peddler dot, strongbox ring-cluster, warning triangle, encampment diamond, extract arrow-circle): redraw all pins from one glyph family (same stroke width, same base shape e.g. circle badge) and vary only fill color by rarity/hazard per the token list

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The backpack is a wide, mostly empty dark slab with tiny, low-contrast text and three lonely item slots, and it sits in a HUD cluttered with competing text blocks, so it looks like a debug panel rather than a AAA inventory.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: The pause card is cleaner and the hierarchy is clearer (lime resume run, quiet secondary buttons, a red abandon run link), but the button stack has four different treatments and the footer is cramped, so it still reads as a decent template and not polished AAA.
findings: P1 button stack (settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new): Give settings the same --ui-panel fill and 1px --ui-line-hi border as every other secondary button. Make report a problem, feedback and what's new one row of three 40px buttons about 125px wide with 8px gaps, so only resume run and settings stay at 56px.

P1 abandon run: Add a 1px --ui-line divider in a 24px gap above it. Make it a 40px full-width button with a 1px --danger border at 50% opacity and 18-20px --danger text. Draw a 2px --danger focus outline, and put a confirm step behind it.
P1 focus state: Draw focus as a 2px --acc outline with a 2px offset plus a --ui-raised fill on whichever button has it. Keep lime fill only for the primary action when it is not focused.
P2 feedback and what's new labels: Set it to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-1, in buttons 40px tall. If the three do not fit in one row at 16px, drop one.
P2 accent tab, top-left of card (x≈720-756, y≈306): Make it 3px by 36px --acc and align it to x=760 on the top edge, or remove it.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: The new settings window is a huge fix (the old one was a broken, empty header stuck at the bottom of a black screen), and it now reads as a real centred card with tabs, rows and focus. But the content is a narrow column with dead side space, the controls float far from their labels, and the bottom of the list and the footer are crowded and cut off.
findings: P1 row controls (chevron, value, chevron): Right-align the stepper group to the row's right padding (16px). Or cap the row at 900px at 1080 so the label-to-control gap is under 400px. Make the chevrons about 24px with a 48px hit area.

P1 list bottom edge / 'how much is out there' row: Size the list to a whole number of 56px rows (at 4K, 112px each) or add a 24px fade mask at the bottom. Widen the scrollbar to 6-8px, with a visible track, and inset it 8px from the panel edge.
P1 window layout / side margins: Keep the 900px-at-1080 measure but align the title, tabs and footer to the same column. Or fill the card with a left category nav and a right detail pane.

P1 detail pane (edit the words): Drop the repeated title and shrink the pane to one 16px tx-2 line. Replace the copy with something neutral like 'changes the in-game wording'. Align the pane's left padding with the row text at x=522.
P2 tab strip: Use 20px tabs with 24px side padding and a 3px underline. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row, or make it a ghost button, and add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

32-keys-window.verdict: A clean, near-full-screen dark card with an x in the corner that matches the window rule, but a flat wall of same-weight rows, tiny section labels, a long gap between each action and its key, and a half-clipped row at the bottom keep it from looking polished.
findings: P1 list bottom edge, rows 'controls list' / 'order your hire': Fade the list out over the last 24px with a gradient mask, or snap the scroll to whole rows and add 16px bottom padding. Make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, brightening on focus.

P1 section headers 'move' / 'fight' / 'world': Set the headers to 16px f-cond 700 in tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the lime bar 3px wide and match its height to the header text, or span the header plus its first row. Keep 24px above each header and 8px below.

P1 row layout, action name vs key cap: Narrow each column to about 760px and give each row a 1px --ui-line bottom divider, or put the key cap directly after a fixed 360px label column. Add a --ui-raised fill for the focused row.
P1 pad focus / selected state: Draw focus as a 2px --acc border on the cap plus a --ui-raised row fill. Show a 'press a key' state with an --acc-ink on --acc cap. Keep the rest quiet.

P2 title bar 'keys' and x: Remove the stray tick or turn it into a 3px by 36px tab drawn on purpose. Make the header row 56px with the title centred vertically. Put the x in a 44px square with a focus border.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: the closer camera makes the player and nearby threats easier to read, but the screen still drowns the one thing that should win, the pillbox alert, under nine simultaneous panels and a triplicated warning.
findings: P0 top-center alert vs left-side event log vs world tag, 1080 shot: drop the floating world tag (keep it on the pillbox icon only, no duplicate text) and let the event log entries fade after ~3s instead of persisting under an active toast; one alert surface, not three.

P0 bottom-center floating keybind panel, overlaps the walkway between player and pillbox: move this to a corner (e.g. bottom-left under hp/stamina) or collapse it to the "f1 full list" toggle only, so the center of the screen is clear during combat; it already has a caret, so default it collapsed after the first few seconds of a raid.

P1 right edge: credits/xp/stash/backpack stack, minimap, run info panel: demote the stat stack to tx-2 (muted) numbers until they change, keep only --acc on the one number that just updated, and tighten panel padding so the column reads as one unit, not three competing boxes.

P1 world tags "pillbox v-64" and "sentry k-98" compared old vs new shot: pin entity name-tag text to a fixed screen size (e.g. --fs-label, 16px) regardless of camera zoom, same as the style guide's other labels, so zoom changes don't silently drift type scale.
P1 whole 1080 frame: during an active alert, auto-dim or shrink the non-combat panels (bots list, keybind card) to ~60% opacity so the eye has fewer equal-weight boxes to parse.

35-kia-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card that mostly follows the shell (red title, one hero number, row of 4 stats, tile row, one primary), but the hero is a banned '$' figure, the secondary text is tiny and dim, and the item tiles are too small and confusingly placed above the number.

38-extracted-card.verdict: solid use of the palette and type scale but it ships two real couch-play gaps: no visible pad focus and unlabeled loot icons.
findings: P1 log run and return button, bottom of card: add a 2-3px --acc outline or --acc-hover fill on the default-focused button so pad focus is visible at 1080 from a couch.
P1 5-icon loot row under the objective text: add a 14px --fs-fine label or count badge (e.g. "x2") under or on each icon, matching the row-name convention used elsewhere in the guide.

P2 'burst carbine recovered to the armoury' line, directly under the checkmarked objective: either give it its own icon/glyph (e.g. a small armoury icon) or drop it to --fs-label/tx-2 weight so it stops competing with the real checkmarked objective.

P2 bottom border under icon 1 (blue) and icon 2 (green) in the loot row: apply the 3px rarity bar from the style guide to every item consistently, or remove it from all five if rarity isn't meaningful here.
P2 card frame, overall: either widen the card toward the guide's standard proportions or add a deliberate secondary element (a thin side rail, map thumbnail) to justify the negative space.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: the x button and accent tab are a step up, but every patch note now cuts off mid-sentence with no punctuation, so the one card whose job is to inform the player reads as broken.
findings: P0 card body, lines 1-3: stop cutting the string; either show the full sentence or truncate at a word boundary and append an ellipsis, then re-screenshot to confirm no mid-word/mid-clause breaks remain.

P0 card frame vs background menu: resize the what's-new card to 90% width per the Window spec, matching settings/stash/shop treatment, or if a small card is intentional for this one card, amend the guide's Window list to exclude it instead of leaving the mismatch.

P1 dismiss controls, bottom of card: keep the x (matches the Q43 window rule) and 'got it' (the one primary action); drop the 'press enter or walk to dismiss' caption or fold it into a 14px fine-print legend under the button instead of running it as a third, equally-weighted option.

P2 note count, items 4 and 5: confirm whether notes 4-5 were intentionally cut for this build; if the list can run long, add a scroll affordance inside the 90%-width card rather than silently truncating entries.

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case, but it is unchanged from the last review: the empty body is centered, the prompt is a dim ring-and-text with no real focus state, and the small card is neither a proper dialog nor a window.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206 x 605-628): Make it a 56px-high primary button with fill #e6ff3d, text #11150a at 20px/700, min-width 200px, right-aligned 24px from the card edge. Or use tx-1 text with a 3px #e6ff3d underline and drop the ring.

P1 card body, 'no scores yet' (x≈906-1014, y≈534): Left-align it at x=714 in tx-2, 20px/400, 24px below the header. Add 3 dim placeholder rows at a 56px pitch ('1 ---', '2 ---', '3 ---') with 1px #2e3337 dividers.

P1 card structure (682-1238 x 412-667): Choose one. For a dialog, make it 480x240 with 24px padding. For a window, make it 90% wide and tall with a 56px header and a 72px footer holding the primary on the right.
P2 close X, top-right of card (1167-1215 x 430-476): Use a 1px #4a5257 border, a 20px close glyph in tx-2, and a 'B' glyph 8px to its left. Inset it 24px from the top and right edges.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (96-210 x 60-88): Set it in tx-2 at 70% opacity, or remove it. If kept, use 32px with a 36px lime tab above it, aligned to x=96.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: lower case and a few small cleanups are the only real gains; the HUD still sits in the screen corners with no safe-zone inset, and none of the earlier P0/P1 layout fixes (labels clear of the hotbar, flat vitals, one active hotbar slot, one run-goals title) were applied.
findings: P0 bottom-left vitals and hotbar (x≈24-535, y≈965-1068): Fix the bars at 360px wide (x=96-456), flat 10px, on --ui-line tracks. Set hp to --ok, stamina to --acc, armour to tx-2. Put 16px labels and values left of or above the bars. Start the hotbar at x≥570 with 24px clear. Inset the block 96px from the left and 54px from the bottom.

65-codex.verdict: The codex is still a small, cramped grid of mismatched tiles floating in the top half of an otherwise empty card, with the same unreadable header stats and no visible focus state, so the earlier advice was not followed.

66-trophy-case.verdict: The trophy cards are tidy individually, but the screen is two-thirds empty, the grid orphans a single card on row two, nothing shows focus, and the header stats and toast are crude.

62-arcade-operator-menu.verdict: The new version is slightly cleaner: the doubled outer ring on the focused row is gone and the close button is smaller. It is still a tiny generic dark card floating in an empty black screen, with no identity and a weak focus read.

P1 card size and hierarchy: Either scale the card to the window standard, or keep it as a compact dialog. Then add a 16px tx-2 state line under the title (for example party size) and raise the row text to 24px with 56px row height. Make the title 32px f-cond 800.

46-arcade-attract-how-to-play.verdict: the how-to-play card is tidy and fully lower case, but the previous fixes were mostly not applied: the prompt is still white with a radio dot, the card is still narrow with small text, and the scrim is still too light, so it reads as a tidy table rather than something polished.

47-arcade-drop-controls-card.verdict: The controls card and the duplicate storm toasts are gone, so the screen reads as a plain in-raid HUD, but the HUD is crowded with mismatched panels, type sizes and styles, and the pad focus and hierarchy are unresolved.

54-arcade-initials-redrop.verdict: The HUD works as an in-raid overlay, but the same extraction event appears four times, the top-centre block is cramped and overlaps, and type sizes, tags and panel styles ignore the guide.
findings: P0 Extraction messaging (centre banner, top toast, left feed, bottom line): Keep one: a 56px hero countdown in --extract at top-centre ('25 s'), plus a 40px toast at most. Delete the left-feed copy, the bottom line and the 'Extraction 0m' label. Make the 25 s the only big number.

P0 Top-centre block: Score / 0 SP / 9:48 / Extraction 0m / arrow / '?' / toast / 'Warden' label: Move the toast to its own slot at y≈96 with 40px height and no overlap. Push the block in from the top by at least 24px. Drop the '?' and the arrow, or put them in the world. Raise the 'Score' label to 16px.

P1 Bottom-centre text: 'Extract in progress! C 25S left', '19 hostiles closing in': Write '25 s'. Remove the 'C'. Put the line on a 40px toast with a 4px danger bar, or drop it. Keep 16px of clear space above the hotbar tag.

P1 Bottom-left feed (Stronghold, Golden enemy, Spotted, Extract): Show at most 3 toasts, each 40px high with a 4px left bar. Use tx-1 text at 16px minimum and a --scrim fill. Remove info toasts that repeat the map state. Hide the grey ones after 3 s.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel: Make the ammo 56px f-cond 800 and the weapon name 20px tx-2. Change the key hint to a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack') at 16px in a footer. Replace '$390' with 'SP 390' or remove it. Shrink the panel to fit its content, with 24px padding.

64-arcade-board-seeded-night.verdict: the card is still a small, quiet dialog with a tiny 'seeded night' line, a bare 'no scores yet', a dim prompt and a blurred, busy backdrop, so nothing here reads as AAA polish.
findings: P1 'seeded night · zbxx' (x713-837, y496): Show only 'seeded night' at 16px f-cond 600, +.04em, in tx-2 #aaa498, 8px under the title. Drop the seed code.

P1 'no scores yet' (x713-820, y545): Draw 5 ghost rows at 40px pitch (rank, name, sp) in --ui-line at 40% opacity under the title block. Keep 'no scores yet' in tx-1 20px above them. No explanatory sentence.

P1 'press any key' prompt (x1027-1206, y612-645): Set the text to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Replace the dot with a 24px key chip showing the live key or pad glyph. Put the right edge on the 24px padding line at x1214. Use --ui-line-hi #4a5257 for the divider at y582.

P1 card and scrim (x681-1239, y400-680): Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and add 2px blur-free darkening. Either widen the card to about 720px with a 24px padding grid, or make it a 90% window with a 56px header and 72px footer.
P2 close x (x1159-1207, y417-465): Make the glyph 20px tx-1 in a 40px box centred on y443, with the right edge at x1214. Draw a 2px --acc border when focused.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The detail pane is now flat, but the settings card still has the same weaknesses as before: a narrow 960px column floating in a 1870px card, steppers stranded mid-row, tiny low-contrast tabs, and a list that is clipped mid-row.
findings: P1 whole card: 960px column centred in a 1870px card, with about 450px of empty void on each side: Widen the list column to about 1400px, or add a 280px left rail for the tabs (the raid, audio, controls...) and give the rows the rest. Left-align the title with the column.

P1 value column: arrows at x≈923 and x≈1175, values at x≈1049: Right-align the stepper to a column ending 24px inside the row. Use 20px tx-1 values and 24px tx-2 arrows, with the arrows turning lime only on the focused row. Give action rows ('change keys') a 1px --ui-line-hi pill or button outline so they read as buttons.

P1 tab strip (the raid ... accessibility) and 'send play data' at the top right: Use 20px tabs with 32px gaps, a 3px lime underline plus tx-1 on the active tab, and tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for the rest. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row or into the footer. Add lb/rb glyphs at the strip ends.

P2 bottom of the list, 'stick deadzone' row (y≈825): Snap the viewport to whole rows (for example 10 × 56px = 560px), or add a 24px gradient mask at the bottom. Make the scrollbar 6px in --ui-line-hi and brighter on focus.

P2 detail pane (keys / rebind...), y≈860-978: Put a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill back at 24px padding, with an 8px gap above the pane. Use a 20px tx-1 title and a 16px tx-2 body trimmed to one short clause, e.g. 'rebind any action; conflicts swap'.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: the haul reveal reads clean at a glance but contradicts its own success check and is missing half the component polish the style guide requires.
findings: P0 objective line vs haul number: gate the checkmark on the actual haul total (haul >= 1200) or drop the objective line when it was not met; never show a check next to a number that contradicts it.
P1 xp line under the title, 'extracted': relabel to 'sp' if this is the score track, or get an explicit ruling from the owner before shipping a new 'xp' currency distinct from $ and sp.

P1 item grid, rows under the recovered-weapons lines: collapse the grid to only the slots that hold items (pack them left-to-right, no empty cells), or if empty slots are intentional capacity indicators, dim them further and add a consistent dashed outline so they read as 'empty' and not 'missing render'.
P1 item icon slots: add the 3px rarity-color bottom or left bar from the token set to every filled slot so the grid matches the Diablo-style rarity read the guide specifies.

P2 'first out . heavy haul . untouched . ghost' row: render each as a small pill/tag (1px --ui-line-hi border, --rad corners, --fs-label text) so they read as discrete earned badges, not a sentence fragment.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: the waiting chip now reads cleanly as the one lime thing (image 2 calms the banner to a raised fill with a thin lime tab), but the screen is still a flat wall of same-weight 16px text with a left-heavy offset layout, a faded half-row at the bottom, and a footer that strands 'esc close' in the corner.
findings: P1 banner 'press a button for sprint · esc cancels': keep the image 2 treatment (--ui-raised fill) with a 3px --acc tab, set text to 20px tx-1, and cut it to 'press a button for sprint'. Move 'esc cancels' to the footer legend at 16px tx-2, and show 'b cancel' on pad.

P1 list rows and chips (all categories): category labels 16px tx-2 uppercase-free with +.04em tracking, no bold. Action names 20px tx-1 weight 600. Idle chips use --ui-raised fill and a --ui-line border. Keep --acc only on the waiting chip.

P1 bottom of list, 'world' row (ping, pause): snap the scroll so the focused row is fully visible, or add a 24px gradient mask to --ui-panel. Make the scrollbar 6px --ui-line-hi, with the thumb in tx-2.

P2 left edge alignment: pick one left edge: align the banner and list to x=49 with the title, or centre a 1440px column and align the title to it. Align category labels and action names to the same inset.

P2 footer 'reset to defaults' and 'esc close': make one 72px footer row: reset on the left, and on the right a legend 'b close · y reset' at 16px tx-2 with pad glyphs. Both items are vertically centred on the same line.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: the settings card is clean, consistent and all lower case, but the detail pane is a huge empty box, the stepper columns float mid-row, and the list is cut off at the bottom, so it still reads as a template options screen.
findings: P1 right detail pane (x=1088-1870, y=116-994): Narrow the pane to about 420px and give the freed width to the list. Or keep it full height and add a 56px f-cond 800 hero readout of the current value ('full') in --acc under the 32px title. Put the description 24px below the title at 20px f-body tx-1 and top-align it.

P1 stepper columns (chevrons x≈731 and x≈982, value x≈857, row x=338-1046): Right-align the cluster to the row edge: chevrons at x≈1000 and x≈1030 with a 160px value cell centred between them. Or shrink the list column to about 560px. Make the chevrons 20px, with tx-2 when idle and --acc when the row is focused.

P1 list bottom (rows 'crosshair' and 'crosshair colour', y≈900-994): End the viewport on a multiple of the 56px row height (for example y=952), 16px above the footer. Limit the fade to the last 24px. Make the thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, inset 8px from the border, with a visible track.

P1 left rail (x=50-313) idle items and 'send play data' (y=555): Set idle items to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 and the selected item to tx-1 on --ui-raised. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of space above 'send play data', and mark it as a utility link in 16px tx-2.

P2 focused row 'render resolution' (x=338-1046, y=117-171) and the detail pane top edge (y=116): Inset the list 8px from the top, or add a 1px --ui-line gap. Make the pane's top tab 36px wide, not full-width, so only the focused row carries the strong lime.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: the new pad diagram is a good identity idea but it is executed with so much lime text and duplicate information that it reads busier and less disciplined than the plain list it replaced.
findings: P0 right diagram panel, all ~16 button-code labels (lt, lb, ls, view, d-up, d-left, d-right, d-down, rt, rb, y, x, b, a, menu, rs): set all diagram button codes to --tx-1 (cream) by default; reserve --acc for only the currently-focused/hovered binding, or drop accent from the diagram entirely since the left list already uses plain text

P0 whole screen: left list (move/fight sections) vs right diagram: pick one source of truth: either drop the text list and let the diagram be the full reference, or keep the list and cut the diagram to only the handful of bindings that benefit from a picture (move/aim sticks)

P1 left column, compare to old screenshot: restore the two-binding-per-row layout in the list column (or remove the redundant list per the finding above) so all five sections fit in the visible area at 1080p
P1 diagram, lead lines from labels to controller sketch: route each lead line with a single bend and at least 8px of separation from any other line; none should cross a circle it doesn't belong to
P2 diagram, 'move'/'aim' circle text and the thin grey lead-lines: set circle labels to --tx-2 minimum (#aaa498) and thicken lead-lines to 1.5px

01-title-mode-menu.verdict: The saves block now lines up with the 558px mode stack and the name field reads in lower case, but the screen still has too many stacked controls, the amber gradient logo clashes with the lime accent, and none of the earlier structural fixes (logo, tagline, server row, top-right buttons) were made.
findings: P1 mode stack, x 681-1239, y 413-693: Delete the server row and the tag. Collapse the two demos into one 'demos' row that opens a sub-list. Fill unfocused rows with --ui-panel and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the focus state a 3px lime left bar on --ui-raised, with a pad 'A' glyph. Keep the 56px row pitch.

P1 logo, x 800-1120, y 265-345: Make the logo flat --tx-1 #efe9dc at about 96px with a 2px dark offset. Delete the tagline or set it at 20px --tx-2. Leave 48px of space between the logo and the stack.

P1 saves block, x 681-1239, y 715-833: Collapse to one 48px row: 'pillager new · 0 raids · $900 · 0 xp', with the name in tx-1 and the stats in tx-2 at 20px, no lime outline, and no 'saves' label. Add a ghost 'switch save' button. Move name entry and 'create a new save' into a 'new save' modal.

P1 name field and buttons, x 681-1239, y 794-831: Remove from the title screen. If it stays, use a 48px high field with a 20px tx-2 'name' label, ghost buttons at 20px text, and a 2px lime focus border.

P1 top-right buttons, x 1611-1823, y 33-80: Keep only 'settings', as a 48px ghost button with 20px text and a --ui-line-hi border, anchored at x 96 from the right edge and y 48. Move fullscreen into settings.

44-title-from-character-select.verdict: The title screen has a clear lime primary button, but the orange-gold gradient logo fights it, the trophy toast overlaps and hides the key-hint legend, and there are capitals on screen, a stacked menu and a saves block with no clear structure.
findings: P0 bottom centre: trophy toast over key-hint legend: Move the toast to the top-centre or the bottom-right, at least 24px clear of the legend (e.g. y=96px). Or lift the legend 56px. Never overlap them.
P0 name field 'PILLAGER': Render the value with text-transform:lowercase and use 'pillager' as the default. Add a 16px tx-2 label 'name'.
P1 'pillagers' logo: Make the logo flat --tx-1 at 800 weight (~96px), or flat --acc. Remove the gradient and shadow so the lime '1 player' button is the only hot element.

P1 menu stack and saves block: Put the menu and saves in one centred 640px column on a 90% --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Use a 56px row pitch with 8px gaps. Give 'saves' a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 label with a 1px divider.
P1 menu content: Hide 'coming later' and group the demos under one 'demos' entry. Delete the duplicate stats line and keep it only in the save row. Aim for 3 to 4 visible actions.

90-legend-full.verdict: The new version only adds a superhot toggle row to the key legend and trims a few lines of copy; the legend is still a big, dense, tiny-text wall that sits over the middle of the playfield and fights with every HUD element.
findings: undefined key legend (centre panel, 735-1170 x 155-927): Split it into a 2-column card sized to content, max ~60% height, with a 32px title ('controls') and a 48px X plus an esc/B hint. Cut it to the ~12 essential bindings. Use --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding.

undefined legend text size and contrast: Set rows to 20px (minimum 16px). Key chips in tx-1 with a --ui-raised fill and 1px --ui-line. Descriptions in tx-2 at ≥4.5:1. Section heads at 16px with +.04em tracking in --acc or tx-1, not amber (--warn is for warnings only). Raise the fill to --scrim .80+ so the map does not show through.

undefined legend column alignment and new last row: Render the backtick as a key chip like the others. Add 1px --ui-line dividers on a 48px row pitch. Keep 8px grid spacing between sections. Move 'f1 hide' into a 16px footer legend with a pad glyph.

undefined HUD colour and weight consistency (pillagers list, run info, concealed tag, codex toast): Map every accent to a token: lime --acc for focus only, --warn for warnings, --extract for extraction. Pull the label out from behind the minimap or clip it cleanly. Cap the HUD to the 5-size scale. Dim or hide the legend's backdrop competition.

undefined run info panel (right, 1585-1900 x 305-445): Use one panel style (same title colour and size for both panels). 16px padding on all sides. Give each objective row a 32px pitch with the count right-aligned in tx-2. Make the chevron ≥24px.

92-settings-superhot-pane.verdict: The window shell is right (centred card, title top-left, X top-right), but the pane is a flat, same-weight list with a clipped row, a mixed-up tab strip and an explanation block, so it reads as an unfinished template.
findings: P0 list bottom edge, 'master volume' row and the detail pane above it: Clip the list at a whole row boundary (56px pitch) with 8px of padding above the detail pane. Remove the audio rows from the 'the raid' group. Add a visible scrollbar track 4px wide spanning the full list height, or a fade at the bottom edge.

P0 detail pane at bottom ('superhot mode / time only moves when you act. / key: `(left of 1)'): Show the description only for the focused row, as a single 16px tx-2 line. Move the key hint to a right-aligned keycap chip. Align the text to the row label x (499). Remove the title that repeats the focused row.

P1 row layout: label at x≈499, stepper arrows at x≈923 and x≈1175, values centred at x≈1049: Put the control block at x≈800–1100, or right-align it to the row edge (x=1420). Make the chevrons 24px, tx-2, with a lime fill on the focused row. Use 20px/600 for values and make the focused value lime.

P1 tab strip ('the raid / audio / controls / controller / display / accessibility' + 'send play data'): Move 'send play data' to the footer as a ghost button or into its own tab content. Set tabs at 20px/600 with 24px side padding and a 48px height. Add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

P1 window card (outer frame) and the centred 960px column: Either widen the list to max 900px with a 5% margin and add a left category rail, or keep the 960px column and drop the full-width dividers. Place the 36px lime top tab inside the header, aligned to the title, or delete it.

60-mapfirst-1p.verdict: the map screen has gone from a blue-purple debug overlay to a proper dark centred card with a title bar, contracts list, footer and one lime main action, and the remaining faults are label collisions around the east blocks and uneven contract rows.
findings: P1 map, east blocks: 'extract b', 'stays open', 'chill row', 'cache' and the blast freezer icon cluster: Move 'extract b' and 'stays open' 24px right, into the empty strip beside the extract icon, and right-align them to that icon. Merge the crate rings into one 24px badge with a count. Move 'chill row' to the block's lower-left corner. Keep every label 8px from its own icon.

P1 contracts panel: progress bars and right column: Give every bar the same x-range, ending 16px before the right-aligned reward and count column. Use a #2e3337 track with a lime fill. Replace 'holding' with '0/1' or hide the bar on those rows. Keep green for 'done' only.

P2 map labels: 'hot ground', 'encampment' x2, 'extract a' and 'closes in 5:00': Set these labels to 16px/600 with a 2px #0b0c0d halo, or switch 'hot ground' to #efe9dc beside the 20px warn glyph. Lower the ring fill to about 12% alpha. Move 'extract a' and its sub-line 16px down and 12px left of the extract icon to clear the ring.

P2 map, zone names (packing floor, the long dock, the sump, scrap line): Set them at 16px/600 #aaa498 with +.04em tracking and a halo. Pin each to an empty top-left corner of its zone, 8px inside the border. Keep pickup labels #efe9dc.

P2 header: 'cold storage', 'sector map', 'dawn · clear', x: Align 'sector map' to the title's baseline with a 16px gap and set it to 20px #aaa498. Put 'dawn · clear' at 16px #aaa498 with a 24px gap to the x. Add a lime focus ring on the x when the pad is on it.

91-snip-panel-raid.verdict: The lime frame, size tag and copy/save actions are clearer than before, but the whole HUD is still at full strength, the controls cheat-sheet still collides with the frame, and the selection is still washed in blue, so it reads as a debug overlay rather than a polished snip mode.
findings: P1 controls cheat-sheet (492-902, 697-867): Hide the sheet while snip mode is active. If it must stay, move it at least 16px clear of the frame (top ≥ 735), use 16px #aaa498 text on a 24px row pitch, and add 16px padding so no row is clipped.

P1 whole HUD (pillagers board, run info, minimap, hotbar, hp/stamina, ammo block, toasts): Fade all HUD to 25% opacity while snipping. Keep only the frame, the size tag and the actions. Show one toast at most.
P1 selection interior (520-1239, 300-719): Remove the blue fill and show the inside at 100%. Dim the outside with --scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)). Add 8px square corner handles on the 2px lime border.

P1 copy / save action box (942-1239, 728-802): Drop the outer box and keep the two buttons only. Use 20px 700 labels, 56px high, 16px below the frame, right-aligned to it. Make save transparent with a 1px #4a5257 border. Add a 2px lime focus ring with a 2px offset.
P2 size tag '720 x 420 px' (520-630, 264-292): Use the panel component: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 text. Sit it flush on the frame's top-left edge. Use '×'.

20-raid-hud-drop.verdict: the closer camera reads fine but it did nothing for the real problem: the hud is still a pile of mismatched boxes fighting each other for the eye.
findings: P0 center screen, y~700-860: codex toast should auto-dismiss after ~3s or move to a corner slot; never render it stacked on the keybind legend, keep max one transient overlay center-screen at a time

P0 whole hud: credits/xp/stash/backpack stack (top right), run info panel, squad list (top left), minimap frame: rebuild all 5 panels on one component: same --ui-panel fill, same --rad 4px, same 24px padding, same header type size (fs-label 16px), delete the per-panel custom backgrounds
P1 run info panel, 3rd contract line: fix the string to its real noun (e.g. "destroy 2 crawlers"), QA every contract string for truncation
P1 keybind legend, lmb row: show only the context-active binding, or label the second row "lmb (item wheel open)" so it's clearly conditional
P1 bottom-left, "standing" tag above the stamina bar: redraw as a --rad 4px rectangle tag matching the hotbar cells and status bars

34-raid-downed-pickups.verdict: the downed plate is now a contained dark card and the career row is a vertical list, but the right column is a crowded stack where the pickup feed, run info, 'extraction available' and the 'concealed' tag overlap each other, and the timer is still not the hero.
findings: P0 right column: run info, pickup feed, 'extraction available', 'concealed · in cover' tag: stack the right column top to bottom with a fixed 16px gap and a 48px right margin: career list, minimap at about 240px tall, run info, then status. Move the pickup feed out of this column to a separate anchor (above the weapon panel, right-aligned). Give 'extraction available' its own 24px row and drop the concealed tag to its own row or into the weapon panel.

P0 top-right career list (credits / xp / stash / backpack): shrink rows to 32px with 16px label text, a 240px width, and tx-2 labels with tx-1 values. Hide world labels under HUD panels, or add a 1px dark outline and keep them at least 16px clear of the HUD.

P1 centre downed plate: 'down' at 32px --danger, the timer at 56px tx-1 as the one hero, one 8px --danger bar, then the prompt at 20px with [f] in a lime chip. Use 24px padding and 16px gaps. Give the plate the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius as the other panels.
P1 run info panel: cap it at 3 contract lines with 24px padding and 8px row gaps, and use tx-1 for names with tx-2 for counts. Keep colour only for status glyphs.

P1 left pickup feed, contract toast and world labels: keep one feed, right-aligned, 3 rows with a 32px row height and an 8px gap, and delete the left one. Use a face where lower-case 'l' and 'i' are distinct. Give world labels a 1px dark outline at tx-1 and a 16px minimum.

36-raid-low-health.verdict: the low-health state is still not urgent: hp 18 sits on an empty black bar with only a thin red outline added, while the clipped career stack, the cluttered key legend and the inconsistent hud panels are all unchanged.
findings: P0 hp bar, bottom left: fill 18% of the bar with --danger #e5482f at 20px tall, pulse it at 1.2s, add a 20% red edge vignette, and set 'hp 18' at 32px tx-1 above the bar with 8px clearance and no tab.

P1 top-right career stack (credits, xp, stash, backpack): move the cache text out of this column or clip it to its row with 16px of clearance. Narrow the rows to about 240px with 8px gaps, hide zero-value rows, and drop the duplicate backpack value. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 key legend, bottom centre: hide it after 30s or collapse it to a single 16px 'f1 keys' hint. If it stays, set the text to 16px, use --tx-2 or lighter for actions, and align the columns on an 8px grid.

P1 hud panels (pillagers list, run info, ammo card, extraction chip, concealed chip): use one panel P (--ui-panel 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding). Set titles to 16px tx-1 with no amber, body 16px minimum, and use lime only for focus. Give contract rows 8px spacing and 16px right padding.

P1 toasts, top centre and left: show one toast at a time, not both. Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 16px and drop the explanation. Remove the duplicate bottom-left chip. Use one toast style with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

51-arcade-alert-reinforcements.verdict: The HUD is still a pile of different-looking widgets: pillager reinforcements shows twice (top pill and left log), the left log is a stack of mismatched pills, and the score, minimap, vitals and ammo panels share no common panel, type scale or padding.
findings: P0 top-centre 'pillager reinforcements' pill plus left event log (both shots): Show a live alert only in the top card. Log only older events, max 3 rows. Delete 'machine has you in sight'. Remove the duplicate pill.

P0 left event log: rain / blackout, stronghold, golden enemy, pillager reinforcements: One row component: fixed 320px wide, 32px high, --ui-panel at 90%, 3px left bar (--warn for info, --danger for threat), 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, 8px gap between rows, max 3 rows with older ones fading out. Drop the info icons.

P1 top-right minimap + 'run info' panel: Drop 'run info'. Make 'run goals' a 16px tx-2 label, goal names 20px tx-1, rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Use 16px padding, a 1px --ui-line divider between rows, an 8px gap below the minimap and a 24px margin from the screen edge.
P1 top-centre score block (0 sp / 9:45 / extract 113m): One Panel P, 16px from the top, containing the 56px f-cond 800 timer, a 20px score and the 16px --extract line with the arrow attached to it.

P1 bottom-left vitals (standing, armour, stamina, hp): Three bars, each 20px high with 8px gaps. Put the 16px label inside the left edge and the value on the right. Use --ok for hp, --extract for stamina and a neutral for armour. Make 'standing' a plain 16px tx-2 label above the bars. Render the damage chip as a tx-1 number.

78-raid-pause-box-full-kit.verdict: a clean, readable pause card with a clear lime primary action and a red abandon, but it is a narrow, generic stack of identical buttons with a stray text box, not the near-full-screen centred card the guide calls for, and the scrim leaves the HUD behind it as muddy noise.
findings: P1 report a problem field: Group 'report a problem' and 'feedback' together as one row, or make it a 56px secondary button that opens a text box. If it stays an input, add a 1px --ui-line-hi border plus a label, raise the placeholder to --tx-2 (4.5:1 minimum), and centre it vertically.

P1 whole card (720-1200 x 238-842): If pause counts as a dialog, document it as an exception in the guide. Otherwise widen it, for example into a two-column layout with the run summary on one side (time, loot, objectives) and the buttons on the other.
P1 background scrim: Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) flat and blur the backdrop by 6-8px, or hide the HUD while the pause card is open.

P2 button stack: Show focus as a 3px lime left bar plus a --ui-raised fill on the focused row. Keep lime fill only for the primary. Move feedback and what's new into a quieter row of two 16px text links, and add a key hint (esc, or the pad button) to resume.
P2 title row: Align the accent tab to x=760 or put it flush on the card's left edge. Shrink the X to 40px with a --ui-line-hi border and a --tx-2 glyph, and bring it to full --tx-1 only on focus.
